subject: Initial phone screen — coordinating across time zones
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>
To: Rafaela Santos <rafaela.santos@gmail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T07:15:00+01:00
Subject: Intro screen — quick availability check

Hi Rafaela,

Thanks again for applying to the Platform Software Engineer role — we enjoyed your GitHub examples. Would you be available for a 25-minute phone screen next week?

I'm based in Berlin (CEST, UTC+2) and the hiring manager, Laura, is in SF (PST, UTC-7). To make scheduling simpler, can you tell us which of these windows works for you (São Paulo time listed in parentheses):

- Tue 2026-11-02, 10:00–12:00 (BRT 06:00–08:00)
- Tue 2026-11-02, 17:00–19:00 (BRT 13:00–15:00)
- Wed 2026-11-03, 08:00–11:00 (BRT 04:00–07:00)

If none work, send a couple of 1-hour windows and we'll try to match. I attached a copy of your resume we downloaded and a short guideline so you know what to expect.

Also: the screen will be with Laura and myself, ~25 minutes, mainly technical background, and a few culture/expectations questions. We use Google Meet — I’ll share the invite once we confirm.

Best,
Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Technical Recruiter (Hiring Ops)
Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-10-30T12:34:00-03:00
Subject: Re: Intro screen — quick availability check

Hi Jonas,

Thanks — excited about the role. I can do Tue 2026-11-02 at 17:30 São Paulo time (that should be 21:30 CEST?). The 17:00–19:00 window you suggested on Tue looks best for me.

If that slot is tight for Laura, I could also do Wed 2026-11-03 at 08:30 CEST (04:30 BRT) but that would be early on my side — prefer the Tue afternoon.

Attached my updated resume in case anything changed. Let me know if you want a different slot.

Best,
Rafaela

Thanks Rafaela — Tue 2026-11-02 at 17:30 CEST (13:30 BRT) actually converts to the candidate time differently; apologies for the confusion. To be explicit:

Proposed confirmed time from our side:
- 2026-11-02 at 17:30 CEST (14:30 BRT) — 25 minutes.

Laura is able to join at 08:30 PST (my 17:30 CEST), which should overlap with your earlier option. Can you confirm that 14:30 BRT works for you? If yes I’ll send a calendar invite with Meet link and include a short agenda.

For transparency: we'll ask about your recent project architecture, two quick system-design prompts, and about team collaboration. No live coding — just conversation.

Thanks,
Jonas
